body_md:
This page lists six roofing companies for people choosing an independently owned roofer in Miami whose Florida license has been checked. Each is a Certified Roofing Contractor with status Current, Active, and an expiration date of 08/31/2028 in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup. Ownership checks found no parent company listed on the Florida filing or, for Art's Roofing & Construction, no parent company named on the company site.

## How we picked

Each license was checked in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup. Facts kept from that lookup are license type, license number, status, expiration date, qualifier, and the lookup URL. Contacts were checked on 2026-11-15. Ownership comes from the Florida filing where it names officers or managers, and from the company site where it states who founded the company or how it is run. Service area, hours, estimates, warranties, permits, financing, and years in business appear only when a checked source stated them. Each entry links to its DBPR result so you can open the same lookup.

## At a glance

- All six licenses are Certified Roofing Contractor, Current, Active, and expire 08/31/2028: CCC1330874, CCC044016, CCC1328901, CCC1332945, CCC1330593, and CCC1333598.
- Stated service areas differ. Big Al's Roofing, LLC lists Miami-Dade County, Broward County, and Port St. Lucie. M. Romero's Roofing & Inspections, Inc. includes Miami, Hialeah, Doral, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Miami Lakes, Hollywood, Pembroke Pines, Fort Lauderdale, West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Boynton Beach, Jupiter, Palm Beach Gardens, and the Florida Keys. Pro-Roofing Systems LLC lists Miami-Dade County, including Miami, plus Broward County, with West Palm Beach County cities available on request. Art's Roofing & Construction lists Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach.
- Where time in business is stated: M. Romero's Roofing & Inspections, Inc. says since 1976; Big Al's Roofing, LLC was founded in 2015; Art's Roofing & Construction was founded in 2020; Pro-Roofing Systems LLC states over 20 years of experience.
- Named on the ownership check: Alvaro Hernandez; Marcos W. Romero; Javier Bencomo; Mauricio Perez Alfonso; Jorge L. Quintanal; and Arturo Stadthagen. Filings or sites also name other officers or managers, and those checks list or name no parent company.

## Things to know before you go

Use the hours that were stated. Big Al's Roofing, LLC is Mon–Fri 8:30–4:30. M. Romero's Roofing & Inspections, Inc. is Mon–Fri 6:00 AM to 4:00 PM, with weekend appointments available. Pro-Roofing Systems LLC is Mon–Fri 8:00am–5:00pm, Saturday 8:00am–1:00pm, and Sunday closed.

Ask for the written paperwork already described. Big Al's Roofing, LLC offers free written line-item estimates and a reply within one business day. M. Romero's Roofing & Inspections, Inc. offers free on-site estimates that are written and itemized. Art's Roofing & Construction offers free inspections and estimates, and the itemized estimate lists the Miami-Dade NOA number of products used. Pro-Roofing Systems LLC says proposals, scopes, and warranties are written with no hidden fees, and an inquiry reply comes within 24–48 hours. It also lists residential and commercial roofing and general construction.

Warranty wording differs, so ask which written terms apply. Big Al's Roofing, LLC states a 10-year labor warranty plus a manufacturer warranty. M. Romero's Roofing & Inspections, Inc. states a written workmanship warranty of 2 or 10 years depending on the system, up to 12 years on some metal roofs, plus a manufacturer material warranty. Art's Roofing & Construction states a written warranty; the length is not stated in the checked facts.

Big Al's Roofing, LLC says permits are pulled in the company name, and that financing is available; terms are not stated. Art's Roofing & Construction says the permit is pulled under license CCC1333598, and that crews are in-house with no subcontractors. Phones in the checked facts: Big Al's Roofing, LLC (305) 900-8297; M. Romero's Roofing & Inspections, Inc. (305) 388-3704; Pro-Roofing Systems LLC 305.790.8582; Art's Roofing & Construction (786) 481-4014 for Miami-Dade and (954) 526-1699 for Broward. Atlas Roofing Inc lists 9245 SW 118th Terr, Miami, FL 33176 as the main address on the license and 142 W 29 St, Hialeah, FL 33012 as the license location address. The checked facts do not include a phone number or website for Atlas Roofing Inc or General Roofing & Construction Corp.

## FAQ

### Are these Florida roofing licenses current?
Yes. The Florida DBPR licensee lookup showed each as a Certified Roofing Contractor, Current, Active, expiring 08/31/2028. Contacts were checked on 2026-11-15. License numbers are CCC1330874, CCC044016, CCC1328901, CCC1332945, CCC1330593, and CCC1333598, and each entry links to that lookup.

### Who is named on the license and in the ownership check?
Qualifiers are Hernandez, Alvaro A Jr; Romero, Marcos W; Bencomo, Javier; Comesana, Anisley; Quintanal, Jorge Luis; and Stadthagen, Arturo. Owner names in the facts are Alvaro Hernandez, Marcos W. Romero, Javier Bencomo, Mauricio Perez Alfonso, Jorge L. Quintanal, and Arturo Stadthagen. Filings also name Christina Sujatha Addison as CFO; Annette Bencomo as vice president; Anisley Comesana as vice president; and Joel Gomez and Julio A. Quintanal Jr. as managers. Company sites say Big Al's Roofing, LLC is owner-operated, M. Romero's Roofing & Inspections, Inc. is still family-run, and Art's Roofing & Construction is family-owned.

### Do they all list the same service area?
No. Big Al's Roofing, LLC lists Miami-Dade County, Broward County, and Port St. Lucie. M. Romero's Roofing & Inspections, Inc. includes Miami plus the cities named above, through parts of Broward and Palm Beach and the Florida Keys. Pro-Roofing Systems LLC lists Miami-Dade County, including Miami, plus Broward County, with West Palm Beach County cities available on request. Art's Roofing & Construction lists Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach. Service area was not included in the checked facts for Atlas Roofing Inc or General Roofing & Construction Corp.; both have a Miami address in the listing.
